title: A General Upper Bound on Multicolor Ordered Ramsey Numbers
summary: We provide a general upper bound on multicolor ordered Ramsey numbers in terms of the interval chromatic number and the degeneracy of an ordered graph. We extend previous results by Conlon, Fox, Lee, and Sudakov (2017) by showing that for every $n$-vertex ordered graph $G^<$ with degeneracy $d\geq2$, and interval chromatic number $χ$, its $q$-color ordered Ramsey number satisfies $r_<(G^<;q) \in n^{O(d^{q-1}\lceil \logχ\rceil^{q-1})}$ for every $q \geq 2$.
